coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 6 ground-truth variable items (67%): shared network architecture, controlled training configuration, standard versus fused Adam implementations, and gradient graph complexity measured using node counts, edge counts, and interpretability.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Uses synthetic random data rather than Omniglot or other standard meta-learning datasets. It also holds TorchViz fixed as the renderer instead of treating TorchViz versus TorchOpt as the visualization-tool independent variable specified in the ground truth.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to state that operation fusion reduces gradient graph complexity, yielding fewer nodes and clearer visualizations when comparing TorchOpt to TorchViz.
